Here is my analysis. Some prose uses braces {like this} before the data.

{"entities": {"people": [{"name": "Greg Abbott"}], "organizations": []}, "citations": [{"title": "Brace {in} a title", "url": "https://example.com/a"}], "keyThemes": [{"phrase": "grid reliability", "relevance": 5}]}

And prose after the object with a stray closing brace } that must not be swallowed.
